notes.general:
add a card that would be instead of anchor, safety net, whatever, and it blocks the next card, whatever is thrown at you. it can be one that can be used on standby, and can be used as many times per match and can be used on anyone. it should bascially be i can trigger it, and cant untrigger it, and if anyone throws anything at me, it automatically uses the card without consent after i have it ready. it shouldnt be like a 'queued' card thing because it should be just like ready to be auto done. name it something magical like idk. but add another card called Mirrored Shield, that just reflects what that person used on you, right back to them. the first one would be like a nope. both of these cards should be very rare
Latest: proposals first. Redesign goggles as ski goggles, not VR headsets. Keep Classic and Slim; replace the other roster designs. Offer card ideas for slots 9–12.
Latest approved: apply all approved pets/cards, remove Echo Cast, Letter Lock and Double Take, exclude victory emotes; lower goggles, Mystic Block name; Classic/Slim preview in admin; matched Last Sip stakes with excess refunds and no sellable trophies.

THE LAST SIP: −5% poison risk
WORD TIDE: 5%: protect a heart
pets.proposal: Keep current bonuses: useful starter without strong sabotage.

pets.name: Kitty
pets.old:
CLASSIC: +1 guesses / turn
THE LAST SIP: +1 pass / match
WORD TIDE: 10%: protect a heart
pets.proposal: Keep +1 mistake; reduce Tide guard to 5% so Bunny has a distinct role.

CLASSIC: +2 guesses / turn
THE LAST SIP: −10% poison risk

pets.name: Piggy

THE LAST SIP: +5% winner pot

pets.name: Foxy

THE LAST SIP: −15% poison risk

THE LAST SIP: +10% winner pot
WORD TIDE: 10%: protect a heart

pets.name: Sparkle
pets.old:
CLASSIC: Save 1 heart / match
THE LAST SIP: Block 1 poison / match
WORD TIDE: Save 1 heart / match
pets.proposal: Keep one shield per match. Show whether it is spent; never refill by re-equipping.

pets.name: Blaze
pets.old:
CLASSIC: 50%: next player gets 3s
THE LAST SIP: −25% poison risk
WORD TIDE: 20%: protect a heart
pets.proposal: Reduce Blaze trigger from 50% to 30%; reduce forced timer from 3 to 6 seconds. Shellback and Frostbite can counter it.

pets.name: Tick-Tock
pets.old:
CLASSIC: +5s on your turns
THE LAST SIP: +5s to decide
WORD TIDE: 25%: protect a heart
pets.proposal: Reduce +5 seconds to +4 seconds; Tide guard from 25% to 20%.

pets.name: Shellback
pets.proposal: Classic: incoming timer reductions cannot shorten a turn below 8 seconds, including Blaze. Roulette: 10% poison resistance. Tide: 10% guard. Defensive only; no time bonus.

pets.name: Frostbite
pets.proposal: Classic: cancel the first Blaze proc each match. Roulette: one antidote against the first lethal poison. Tide: 15% guard. Counter is consumed and shown to everyone.

pets.name: Bulwark
pets.proposal: Classic: reduce Piggy, Grizzly and Time Tax penalties by 1 second. Does not block Blaze. Roulette: +1 pass. Tide: 10% guard.

pets.name: Moon Moth
pets.proposal: Classic: block the first mistake-reduction card. Roulette: +2 sip seconds. Tide: 15% guard. Does not block direct heart damage.

cards.name: Free Pass
cards.old: Skip your own or another player's next turn. No heart lost!
cards.proposal: Royal only, 4% chance. No heart lost; one card action per turn.

cards.name: Time Tax
cards.old: Give the player you choose 2 fewer seconds on their next turn.
cards.proposal: Keep effect; enforce one card action per turn.

cards.name: Narrow Margin
cards.old: The player you choose gets 2 fewer allowed mistakes on their next turn (at least 1).
cards.proposal: Keep effect; enforce one card action per turn.

cards.name: Heartbreaker
cards.old: Remove someone else's heart. A pet shield can block it.
cards.proposal: Royal only, 5% chance. Keep one heart damage and shield counter.

cards.name: Extra Beat
cards.proposal: Add 3 seconds to your own next turn; cap total extra time at 5 seconds. Standard crate.

cards.name: Safety Net
cards.proposal: Block the next heart loss once; expires after one round. Cannot stack with another shield. Royal.

cards.name: Second Chance
cards.proposal: Add one allowed mistake on your next turn; expires when that turn ends. Standard.

cards.name: Clean Slate
cards.proposal: Clear queued time and mistake penalties on yourself before the next turn begins. Royal.

cards.name: Slow Burn
cards.proposal: Remove 1 second from the target’s next two turns; 6-second floor; no stacking. Standard.

cards.name: Mirror
cards.proposal: Reflect the next hostile card once; reflected effects cannot reflect again. Royal.

cards.name: Lifeline
cards.proposal: Restore one heart to yourself, up to the starting maximum; cannot revive eliminated players. Royal.

cards.name: Anchor
cards.proposal: Block the next hostile Free Pass once; self-used Free Pass remains allowed. Standard.
